source.author: lucan
source.text: Non plura locuto, Avulsit laceros, percussa puppe, rudentes Turbo rapax, fragilemque super volitantia malum Vela tulit: sonuit victis compagibus alnus.
source.text_original: Non plura locuto, / Avulsit laceros, percussa puppe, rudentes / Turbo rapax, fragilemque super volitantia malum / Vela tulit: sonuit victis compagibus alnus.
source.text_english: When he had spoken no more, the rapacious whirlwind, striking the boat, tore away the ropes, torn apart, and carried off the sails over the flying mast; the alder hull rang with its shattered joints.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: excussi manibus remi, conversaque frontem puppis in oblicum resonos latus accipit ictus, vela super tremulum subitus volitantia malum turbo rapit.
reuse.text_original: excussi manibus remi, conversaque frontem / puppis in oblicum resonos latus accipit ictus, / vela super tremulum subitus volitantia malum / turbo rapit.
reuse.text_english: The oars were struck from their hands, and the ship, its prow turned askew, receives the echoing blows on its side; then a sudden whirlwind snatches the sails, fluttering above, from the trembling mast.
